svg.title: Bounded upstream retrieval, compilation, and semantic evaluation
svg.desc: An upstream candidate receives progressively wider retrieval, optional relevance reranking, complete evidence closure, compiled model input, semantic observations, constraint resolution, and policy evaluation. Each round records lineage and either stops or acquires more evidence without publishing graph changes.
